description.value: Ah Long Sushi is a Japanese restaurant on the busy West Broadway cycling corridor in Vancouver's Kitsilano neighbourhood. It distinguishes itself by serving mixed black rice and brown rice alongside its sushi menu, a nod to health-conscious options. Cyclists passing through on the Broadway route will find it a sit-down spot with online ordering and local delivery available.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website successfully loaded and confirms the business is active with online ordering, matching OSM name, address (2697 West Broadway Vancouver V6K 2G2), and phone (604-730-9229). No evidence on the website or in OSM tags addresses bike parking, washrooms, water refill, Wi-Fi, or other cycling amenities. Takeout is confirmed true via the prominent 'Online Order' and delivery references on the site.
concerns: OSM opening_hours tag shows 'Sa, Su 00:00-21:00' (midnight open) which appears to be a data entry error; website states Saturday & Sunday hours start at 12:00pm.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, active restaurant on a major Vancouver cycling corridor with a functioning website and confirmed contact details.
